## What changed

<!-- In short, plain sentences: what you can see or do now, and why. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] A change to the app (`index.html`, `style.css`, `appconfig.json`, `icon.svg`, `icon.png`, `js/`, `vendor/`) has a line in
      `CHANGELOG.md` and a new version: `npm run bump -- patch`, `minor` or `major`.
- [ ] New code has tests: `npm run coverage` finds no new code that no test runs.
- [ ] Something you can see changed: `README.md`, `designs/` and the design canvas show it.
- [ ] The app reads a new kind of wiki page: `tests/live.spec.js` checks it.
- [ ] Saved data changed shape: old saved data still works (and the matching `*_VERSION` went up).
